two_liner: FYN (Fuel Your Nutrition) brings the world's most powerful superfood, spirulina, into your daily routine — improving nutrient absorption, cellular health and whole-body wellness with simple, delicious blends.
brief_description: India faces a double nutrition gap — low intake and poor absorption — and most supplements fail because weak gut health and genetics limit cellular uptake, leaving people stuck in a loop of products that don't work. FYN closes the gap with spirulina, the most bioavailable natural superfood, engineered into delicious blends built for habit and consistency. We're not another bottle on a cluttered shelf — we're India's first spirulina-first, routine-driven nutrition system. Daily, naturally, effectively.

sector_excitement.paragraph: India's nutraceuticals and functional-food market is one of the fastest-growing globally, driven by urban health-consciousness, post-pandemic immunity demand, and a generational shift from generic supplements to ingredient-led wellness. Spirulina sits at the intersection of two booming categories — superfoods and functional beverages — and the bioavailability conversation that's gone mainstream in the US (Erewhon's blue spirulina drinks sell out daily) is now landing in India.

product_excitement: Most wellness brands sell ingredients. FYN sells consistency. Supplements fail when they're badly absorbed and inconsistently taken — so we built around the most bioavailable natural superfood (spirulina) and engineered every blend for habit, taste and repeatability. We're not another bottle on a cluttered shelf; we're the first spirulina-first, routine-driven nutrition system in India, built to make wellness visually exciting, culturally relevant and behaviourally easy.
